inputs.name: hand over from Data Contracts to Data Ingestion Pipeline

output.level_0: The hand over is broken because the ingestion pipeline rejects the contract schema entirely.
output.level_1: No hand over exists, so data contracts and ingestion operate as completely separate, disconnected systems.
output.level_2: A human manually copies the data contract definition into the ingestion pipeline configuration every week.
output.level_4: A formal sign off verifies the hand over, ensuring the contract matches the ingestion pipeline exactly.
